item.title: 5x8 vs 8x10 Rug: What Size Rug for a Small Living Room?
item.description: Not sure what size rug fits a small living room? This comparison of 5x8 and 8x10 rugs explains how each one works with your sofa, chairs and coffee table, and how to test the size with painter's tape before you buy. Save it before you shop for a rug.

item.title: Round vs Rectangle Coffee Table: Which Is Better for a Small Living Room?
item.description: Choosing a coffee table for a small living room? Round tables are easier to walk around and soften a boxy room, while rectangles match long sofas and hold more. Compare both before you buy.

item.title: 6 Small Living Room Lighting Ideas That Make the Room Feel Bigger
item.description: One ceiling light makes a small living room feel flat and smaller than it is. These 6 lighting ideas add warmth, depth and space: floor lamps, sconces, LED strips and more. Most need no electrician. Save for your next refresh.
